countries.reasoning: Based on USGS and major industry reports for 2023, China is the largest coal producer globally, providing nearly half of global coal output with very reliable data.
India consistently ranks as the second largest coal producer, producing about 11% of global carbon in the form of coal; data is well-documented by Indian Ministry of Coal and international sources.
US coal production data from EIA and USGS for 2023 shows about 9% global share; well-documented, with stable production trends.
Indonesia is a major coal exporter and producer, contributing around 7% of global production; data from Indonesian government and industry sources.
Russia is a significant coal producer with roughly a 5% global share; data from Russian ministries and international agencies.
